description: Source code implementing filename utilities for URL-based filename extraction, extension correction, and filename sanitization within the Chromium project.

methods.name: GetCorrectedExtensionUnsafe
methods.description: Determines the correct file extension based on MIME type and filename, avoiding unsafe or incorrect extensions.

methods.name: SanitizeGeneratedFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes a filename by trimming whitespace, replacing path separators, and handling trailing dots/spaces.

methods.name: GetFileNameFromURL
methods.description: Extracts a filename from the URL's last path component, decoding it appropriately and indicating if extension should be overwritten.

methods.name: IsShellIntegratedExtension
methods.description: Checks if a file extension is automatically integrated into the Windows shell.

methods.name: EnsureSafeExtension
methods.description: Ensures the filename has a safe and appropriate extension based on MIME type, avoiding shell-integration extensions.

methods.name: FilePathToString16
methods.description: Converts a FilePath to a UTF-16 string representation.

methods.name: GetSuggestedFilenameImpl
methods.description: Generates a suggested filename based on URL, content disposition, suggested name, and other parameters.

methods.name: GenerateFileNameImpl
methods.description: Creates a filename for a download based on URL, headers, and other parameters, returning a FilePath.
